# Vault Conventions

> **Role:** The dialect of this Johnny.Decimal system, written once, in a form both people and scripts read.
> **Status:** Active
> **Consumed by:** `jd-file`, `jd-audit` (and its validator), and any future skill that needs to speak this vault's dialect.

Fixture variant: a single-substrate system whose `[rules].scaffold_names` names the `Overview.md` that `jd-file` drops into every ID it mints. It exists to pin one behavior — an ID holding only its scaffold still reports `hygiene-empty`, and one holding a scaffold plus real payload does not.

```toml
schema_version = 1

[system]
name = "kma-fixture-scaffold-empty"
multi_system = false
register_grammar_version = 1

[[substrate]]
id = "vault"
label = "Obsidian vault"
shape = "areas"
scope = ["*"]
holds = "notes, memory, decisions, the register and constitution"
primary = true

[hosts.jdaudit-fixture]
label = "smoke-test fixture host"
vault = ["__FIXTURE_ROOT__/vault"]

[discovery]
vault = ["__FIXTURE_ROOT__/vault"]

[grammar]
area = '^(?P<a_lo>\d\d)-(?P<a_hi>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
category = '^(?P<cat>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
id = '^(?P<cat>\d\d)\.(?P<item>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
# A fourth numbered tier (AC.ID.NN). Matched so it can be reported, not allowed.
deeper = '^(?P<cat>\d\d)\.(?P<item>\d\d)\.(?P<sub>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'

[register]
path = "00-09 Admin & Meta/00 System/00.02 JDex.md"
area_heading = '^## (?P<a_lo>\d\d)-(?P<a_hi>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
category_heading = '^### (?P<cat>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
entry = '^- `(?P<id>\d\d\.\d\d) (?P<label>[^`]+)` — (?P<purpose>[^\[]+?)(?: \[(?P<substrates>[^\]]*)\])?(?:\s+(?P<tags>#\S+(?:\s+#\S+)*))?\s*$'
substrate_separator = ", "
# Entry is known-disputed, pending reconciliation; findings about it downgrade to info.
conflict_tag = "#conflict"

[constitution]
path = "00-09 Admin & Meta/00 System/00.00 Johnny Decimal Index.md"
area_heading = '^### (?P<a_lo>\d\d)-(?P<a_hi>\d\d) (?P<label>.+)$'
# Unindented bullets only: indented ones are ID examples, not categories.
category_line = '^- `(?P<cat>\d\d) (?P<label>[^`]+)`'

[rules]
# Numbering stops at AC.ID. Depth below an ID is unnumbered, free-form, and
# deliberately deep. The invariant is "no fourth numbered tier", not "no nesting".
max_numbered_depth = 3
numbered_depth_below_id = false
standard_zeros = false
require_contiguous_ids = false
meta_slot_item = "99"
files_at_area_level = "forbid"
files_at_category_level = "allowlist"   # see [[exceptions]]
# Skill-scaffolded files that don't count as payload for hygiene-empty.
scaffold_names = ["Overview.md"]

[substrate_selection]
follow_category_precedent = true
when_category_empty = "ask"
default = "vault"
notes = "vault"

[naming]
id_folder = '^\d\d\.\d\d .+$'
hand_authored_note = '^[^/]+\.md$'
skill_managed_note = '^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d(-\d{4})?-[a-z0-9-]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}\.md$'
memory_record = '^[a-z0-9-]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10}\.md$'
never_rename_skill_managed = true

[links]
pattern = "file:///[^\\s)\\]\"'<>]+"
percent_encoded = true
verify_on_current_host = true
report_translated_equivalent = true

[ignore]
vault_top_level = ["Notion", "_Dailies", "Clippings"]
names = [".git", ".obsidian", ".DS_Store", ".stfolder", "node_modules", ".trash"]
link_scan_skip = ["00-09 Admin & Meta/00 System"]
```
